pages.text: The $(bold)Hemp Core$() is the mid-game progression gate. Every machine in this mod requires one. Without it, you cannot build the Generator, Grinder, Extractor, Liquifier, Mutator, Sequencer, or Synthesizer.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Crafting requires:$()$(br)1. First craft $(bold)Unfinished Hemp Core$() (Diamond + Amethyst Shard + Redstone + Glowstone Dust)$(br)2. Then combine: Hemp Hammer + Hemp Plastic + Unfinished Hemp Core → Hemp Core$(br)$(br)$(bold)Required resources:$() 1 Diamond, 1 Amethyst Shard, Redstone, Glowstone Dust, Hemp Plastic, Hemp Hammer
Step 1: Craft the Unfinished Hemp Core.
Step 2: Combine with Hemp Hammer and Hemp Plastic to finish it.
